reference_audio.note: Optional: omit for voice design mode (describe the voice in parentheses at the start of text).  ~3 s is enough for high-quality cloning.  Provide reference_text for ultimate cloning (audio continuation mode).

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample as a base64 string (optional).  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...).  ~3 s is enough for high-quality cloning.  Omit for voice design mode (describe the voice in parentheses at the start of text, e.g. "(A young woman, gentle voice) Hello there.").

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.description: Exact transcript of the reference audio (optional).  When provided alongside audio_base64, enables ultimate cloning mode: the model treats the reference as a spoken prefix and continues from it, faithfully reproducing every vocal detail.  Without reference_text, only controllable cloning (timbre copy) is used.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. 'en', 'zh' (accepted but not forwarded — VoxCPM2 auto-detects language from text content across 30 languages).  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.

parameters.name: cfg_value
parameters.description: Classifier-free guidance scale.  Higher values increase expressiveness and adherence to style cues.  Omit for the engine default (2.0).

parameters.name: inference_timesteps
parameters.description: Number of diffusion inference steps.  More steps = higher quality but slower.  Omit for the engine default (10).
